ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this“Agreement"),made as of August3,2018,by and betweenMAPLE3PKRL175PEARL OWNER,LLC,aDelaware limited liability company having an address c/o Normandy Real Estate Partners, 53 Maple Avenue, Morristown, New Jersey 07960 ("Lot 5 Owner"), and 90 SANDS OWNER LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address c/o RFR Holding LLC, 390 Park Avenue, New York, New York 10022 ("Lot 9 0wner"). RECITALS: 1.Lot 5 Owner is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and other improvements thereon as of the date hereof, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, in the City and State of New York,known by the street address of 175 Pearl Street, Brooklyn,and as Tax Lot 5 of Block 87 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Borough of Brooklyn (the “Tax Map"), as more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Lot 5 Land"; said buildings, together with any further additions, alterations or replacements thereof, being herein called the “Lot 5 Building(s)"; and the Lot 5 Land and Lot 5 Buildings, collectively, being herein called the “Lot 5 Premises"); 2.Lot 9 Owner is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and other improvements thereon as of the date hereof, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, in the City and of Block 87 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Lot 9 Land"; said buildings, together with any further additions, alterations or replacements thereof, being herein called the “Lot 9 Building(s)"; and the Lot 9 Land and Lot 9 Buildings, collectively, being herein called the “Lot 9 Premises"); 3. In accordance with the procedure available pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective as of December 15, 1961, as amended (the "Zoning Resolution"), the Lot 5 Land and Lot 9 Land have been declared to be a single “zoning lot" (the “Zoning Lot"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution, pursuant to that certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions dated December 22, 1989, and recorded in the Office of the City Register for Kings County at Reel 2492, Page 1235; 4. Lot 5 Owner and Lot 9 Owner now propose to amend and restate the aforementioned Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, in the form attached in Exhibit C, which will be recorded in the Register's Office immediately prior to the recording of this Agreement (as amended and restated, the "Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions"); 5.
